scripts.test: bun test shared/ features/ apps/ scripts/
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@noter/web' gen && bun run --filter '@noter/sync-worker' typecheck && tsc --build && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:html
scripts.postinstall: bun install --cwd tools/markuplint --frozen-lockfile || bun install --cwd tools/markuplint
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run e2e
scripts.clean: find . -maxdepth 3 -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && bun install
